title: Unique Plants
description: Adds new plants with unique and strange traits like flowers that make you float to a bush that can teleport you to any dimension
body:
Unique plants adds strange plants to your world that have weird abilities and different generation conditions, currently there are 5 plants that have been added:

- void flower - keeps you close and despawns mobs that touch it
- dimensional bush - teleports you to a different dimenson based on how you interact with it
- floater - takes you into the air
- soul flower - steals exp
- volcanic flower - absorbs fire on you
